messages:
kevin_pm: Quick sync — PRD scope for console observability features. NimbusHealth asked for long-term retention (7 years) + export to S3 with per-tenant keys. Can we support this without exploding costs?

sara_prod: High-level: tiered retention (hot/cold/archival) + export-on-write sounds right. Need acceptance criteria and safety rails.

jon_eng: Technical constraints: 1) cold storage must be cheap (glacier-like), 2) queryability for older data will be limited, 3) rollbacks for deletions need audit trail.

adi_design: UX questions: who triggers export? admin-only? UX flow options: a) scheduled export b) customer-triggered ad-hoc c) auto-archive with retrieval request. Need mockups for each.

maria_sre: Compliance: long retention + per-tenant KMS -> we must ensure key rotation and export logs (immutable). Also SLO implications: restore/restore-time must be defined.

kevin_pm: Propose minimal MVP: - retention tiers (30d hot, 1y warm, archival export to customer S3 after 90d opt-in) - admin export UI + API - per-tenant export logs to meet audits. Thoughts?

jon_eng: MVP feasibility: yes for export to customer S3 (presigned multipart + server-side copy). Archival retrieval will be async. We'll need a background job and throttling. Perf targets: index hot data for sub-200ms queries; archive queries may be minutes.

adi_design: I'll sketch two flows tonight: Admin-export (single tenant) and Bulk-scheduled export. Need a tiny confirmation modal and progress indicator.

kevin_pm: Acceptance criteria draft (for PRD):
- retention UI to configure tiers per org (hot/warm/archival) (verify saved)
- export API: initiate export -> returns job_id -> job status endpoints (job must fail gracefully)
- per-export audit log entry + KMS key id recorded
- hot queries for data <=30d must meet 200ms p95 under baseline load
- archival retrieval must complete within SLA (TBD, initial target 24h)

sara_prod: Add safety gates: default off for archival export, require billing approval for >1TB/month, and soft quota per-tenant export concurrency limit.

maria_sre: Edge cases: - partial export failures (network) -> resume support; - key-unavailable (customer rotated) -> fail with clear remediation; - GDPR deletion requests spanning archived exports -> must propagate and remove in downstream S3 when requested.

jon_eng: Implementation notes: use export-job table with incremental checkpoints, store manifests in our control plane, use background worker with idempotency token. Can reuse existing job-runner infra. Need schema change (small).

infra-bot: CI check: export-job migration diff: 2 files changed. Tests: unit + integration (mock S3).

kevin_pm: Launch criteria proposal:
- engineering implements retention UI + export API + background job + audit logs
- end-to-end smoke: export -> verify manifests in S3 -> import/retrieve test
- perf: hot query p95 <=200ms (measured in staging)
- compliance checklist signed by SRE and Security (KMS, audit replay)
- docs: product FAQ and runbook for failed exports

adi_design: UX acceptance: flows implemented + accessible confirmation modal + progress state + error states with clear CTAs.

sara_prod: Prioritization: split into two sprints: sprint A = UI + API + small export to single obj store, sprint B = per-tenant KMS + billing guardrails + GDPR support. Customers with urgent needs get pre-launch contract.

maria_sre: I'll draft the compliance checklist and required logs, share in the channel by EOD.

kevin_pm: Action items:
- jon_eng: prototype background job & migration (owner)
- adi_design: mockups for admin/bulk export (due tomorrow)
- sara_prod: update PRD with acceptance criteria and gating policy (due Fri)
- maria_sre: compliance checklist + KMS runbook (EOD)

jon_eng: Ack, starting prototype. Will post rough timeline by EOD.

sara_prod: +1. If we can keep initial cost model simple (storage delta + export egress), we'll iterate on pricing.

kevin_pm: Cool — we'll reconvene after mockups and prototype. Thanks all :thumbsup:
